notes: The public profile intentionally excludes serial numbers, hardware UUIDs, hostnames, and account names.
The exact Windows and Python versions are captured separately in every immutable run specification.

The launcher records the active power-scheme GUID with a localization-independent tag and GetSystemPowerStatus AC/battery state at launch; the controller repeats these observations immediately before and after every task.
Power scheme is provenance rather than an eligibility gate. AC power, battery saver off, and the launcher-owned system-sleep assertion are required for benchmark execution.

Changing power scheme never changes the protocol fingerprint; every task retains both boundary observations so reports can identify single-mode, mixed-mode, unavailable-mode, and mixed-within-task results.
Operator-controlled settings are frozen in the profile but must still be confirmed before each uninterrupted machine run.
